tools.name: ping
tools.description: Health check for the Hey Anon MCP server. Returns "pong" and the server time (ISO 8601). No API key required.

tools.name: get_api_key_setup_url
tools.description: Get the URL of the Hey Anon page where the user logs in and creates an API key, plus the MCP config snippet where the key goes (X-API-Key header). Call this when a tool fails with "API key not set" or the user has no key yet. The key is never passed through the chat. No API key required.

tools.name: wallet_list
tools.description: List the user wallets registered in Hey Anon: display name, type (evm, solana, ton, etc.), address, labels and whether the wallet is archived. Call it before ask_anon to choose which addresses to attach (at most one per type); match the wallet the user names by display name, label or address and ski

tools.name: ask_gemma

tools.name: isProcessing
tools.description: Check whether Anon is still processing the previous ask_anon request. Returns "isProcessing: true|false". Use before sending another message, or when a request looks stuck (then call abort).

tools.name: abort
tools.description: Force-stop Anon processing of the current ask_anon request. Use only when isProcessing stays true for too long or the request is stuck; otherwise wait for the background task to complete.

tools.name: projects
tools.description: List the protocols and integrations Anon can operate (swaps, lending, staking, bridges, CEX, etc.): name, key, description, supported networks, tool count. Use it to check whether Anon supports a protocol or network before asking.

tools.name: scheduled_task_list
tools.description: List the user scheduled tasks: automations created through Anon that run at a given time or when a price condition is met. There is no create/update tool: to create an automation, ask Anon via ask_anon (e.g. "Buy 0.1 ETH on Base when ETH drops below 2000"), then use this tool to confirm it exists. R

tools.name: scheduled_task_get
tools.description: Get one scheduled task by id (from scheduled_task_list). Returns id, description, status, type and taskExecutorResponse (the last execution result).

tools.name: scheduled_task_delete
tools.description: Delete (cancel) a scheduled task by id. Irreversible: the automation will not run again. Returns a confirmation.

tools.name: portfolio_tokens
tools.description: Token balances for every user wallet (addresses taken from wallet_list) across all supported networks. Returns JSON [{ walletAddress, data }]; for EVM wallets data.evm is keyed by chain id, Solana balances are in data.solana. Output can be large with many wallets.

tools.name: portfolio_transactions
tools.description: Recent transactions for every user wallet (addresses taken from wallet_list). Returns JSON [{ walletAddress, data }]. Output can be large with many wallets.

tools.name: portfolio_defi
tools.description: DeFi positions (LP, staking, lending, vaults, etc.) for every user wallet (addresses taken from wallet_list). Returns JSON [{ walletAddress, data }].

tools.name: portfolio_cex
tools.description: Balances and positions from the exchange accounts linked to Hey Anon (e.g. Hyperliquid, keyed by exchange). Pass address (an EVM wallet from wallet_list) when the user has several EVM wallets, otherwise the backend rejects the call. Returns the raw JSON response.

tools.name: background_task_list
tools.description: List the user Anon background tasks (one per ask_anon message): id, prompt, status, result (Anon reply when completed), logs, createdAt, updatedAt. Use it to find earlier answers or check what is still pending. Also returned as structuredContent { tasks }.

tools.name: background_task
tools.description: Get one Anon background task by id. tools.description: Delete a background task record by id.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "address_book_list" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
